schemes.title: Pragati Scholarship for Girls
schemes.eligibility: The scheme is open to girls studying in Class 11 at a government school in the state.
schemes.benefit: Each selected student receives Rs. 10,000 per annum.

schemes.title: Merit Scholarship for Class 9
schemes.eligibility: Students of either gender studying in Class 9 who scored well in Class 8 may apply.
schemes.benefit: The award is Rs. 6,000 per annum.

schemes.title: Science Talent Award
schemes.eligibility: Boys and girls with Science are eligible for this award.
